name: file-organizer
description: Tidy a directory by grouping files by type. Always dry-runs first.
preconditions: directory exists and is not a system path
steps: list the directory and propose a grouping plan (dry-run)
show the plan and wait for user approval
move files only after approval, never delete
validation: no file deleted; every moved file listed with old and new path
failure_recovery: stop on first error and report the untouched remainder
cautions: dry-run first, move only after approval
never delete files; never touch system, home-root, or hidden paths
never follow symlinks outside the target directory
